description: Parcel boundaries joined to assessor/tax-roll attributes (owner, acreage, value, year built, building sqft, property class) via the statewide Land Information Records (LIR) schema. The authoritative growth/housing base layer for Weber County.
publisher: UGRC / Utah SGID (with Weber County Assessor)
notes: 29 fields. Do NOT bulk-download; query by bbox/where. Land value, built year, unit counts per parcel - the base for every housing/growth question in unincorporated Weber.

description: Parcel boundary polygons only (no tax-roll attributes).
notes: 17 fields, geometry only. Prefer the LIR variant unless only geometry is needed. (Fewer polygons than LIR rows: LIR is exploded to tax records.)

description: Point locations for every USPS-assigned address in Utah; the state's authoritative geocoding base.
notes: Statewide; filter to Weber by county field or bbox. Backs address->jurisdiction lookups.

description: Incorporated municipal (city/town) boundaries statewide, maintained with annexation updates.
notes: Which land is in which city vs UNINCORPORATED Weber - the frame for the county PC jurisdiction (Ogden Valley + Western Weber unincorporated areas). Filter to Weber by county field.

description: County boundary polygons statewide (includes Weber County / FIPS 49057).
notes: County extent for clipping/joins. Weber FIPS 49057.

description: UGRC work-in-progress generalized zoning layer for participating Utah jurisdictions.
notes: Sparse statewide coverage - may not include unincorporated Weber. For authoritative Weber zoning use the county Land Use Code + county GIS below.

description: Weber County GIS ArcGIS Online org (maps, apps, and county-authored layers incl. zoning, general-plan land use, addressing).
notes: County's own authoritative zoning / future-land-use / addressing layers. Enumerate its FeatureServers when building parcel-level land-use analysis; not mirrored here (catalog-only pass).

description: Public interactive parcel/zoning/aerial map viewer for Weber County.
notes: Human-facing viewer; backing services are the county ArcGIS org layers above. Good for one-off parcel/zoning lookups.
